warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3 at 3.00 + 3.00 (6.00); y = A-B-C-D-E at 1.50 + 1.00 + 2.50 + 1.50 (6.50). Origin A1. The same main chains print on S-01, S-02, S-03, รูปตัด A and รูปตัด B. Vector CAD PDF whose dimension text is drawn as geometry (no text layer for the numbers) — every value read off the rendered page.

Two different edges above A: S-02 (structure plan) and รูปตัด B print 2.00 beyond A to the outer GS slab edge (A' -2.00), S-03 (roof frame) prints 1.00 to the roof eave (A'' -1.00). Both kept as lines. Below E both sheets print 1.00, so the slab edge and the roof eave share E' (7.50).

Truss elevations (S-04) print no grid bubbles. Their supports were matched to the plans from the drawn posts and member callouts: T1 (grid 1) has posts at E, D, C, A — exactly the grid-1 columns (no column at B1) and its 1.50 | 2.50 | 2.50 chain equals E-D, D-C, C-A; T2 (grids 2, 3) has posts at E, D, B, A — the grid-2/3 columns (no column at C2/C3), chain 1.50 | 3.50 | 1.50. The left end of both carries เสริมรับจันทัน +2.80, which S-03 puts on row E, so the elevations read E (left) to A (right). Truss T3 (row C) prints T1 / T2 / T2 at grids 1 / 2 / 3. Panel ticks therefore became dummies per section 4 rule 4: y A''' 0.75, A'''' 1.25, C' 3.75; x 1'' 1.00, 1'''' 2.00, 2' 4.00, 2''' 5.00 (plus 1''' 1.50 and 2'' 4.50 from the S-03 rafter sub-chain).

Dimension sweep covers S-01..S-04 plus รูปตัด A / รูปตัด B (A-07, A-08) for the levels. Elevations A-05/A-06, floor plan A-03, roof plan A-04, A-09 sanitary standard, A-10 door/window elevations, E-01, SN-01, SN-02 were not dimension-swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run. S-05 / S-06 print only member-internal dimensions (footing plan sizes, thicknesses, section sizes) and the truss depths 0.785 / 0.345 / 0.677 are truss-internal — those stay on their elements.

z: two levels share the printed label ระดับหลังอะเส (+2.80 and +3.20) on รูปตัด A/B, so their ids carry the printed value. The +2.80 member is called เสริมรับจันทัน on S-03 / S-04 / the รูปตัด B callout — label kept as printed, conflict noted on the level. The truss elevations print 0.785 from the อะเส line to the ridge while รูปตัด A/B print 0.68 from ระดับหลังอะเส +3.20 to ระดับหลังอกไก่ +3.88; both kept as printed (different reference points on the truss vs the roof finish, not reconciled).
